A bot needs a BotFather token to run, so this is a reading, not a run: for each one, who it serves when you set no allowlist, and for bots that drive a coding agent, what stands between a Telegram message and a command on your machine. title: Claude Code review tools, tested on the same 12 pull requests
实测对比：同样的 12 个 PR
intro: On 2026-10-10 we ran 16 of these tools and 13 ran. Each reviewed the same 12 pull requests against a small Python service in a throwaway sandbox: 8 carry one planted defect (an off-by-one, an SQL injection, a card token in the logs, a missing permission check, a retry that never ends, a swallowed error, an inverted condition, a weakened test) and 4 are clean. Two numbers per tool, as in SWR-Bench: defects found, and blocking findings on the clean ones. A judge (gpt-6-astra, three passes) marked each review. Claude Code with no tool installed did the same job as a control.

2026-10-10 我们实跑了其中 16 个，跑成 13 个。每个在用完即删的沙箱里审同样的 12 个 PR（一个小型 Python 服务）：8 个各埋了一个缺陷（差一错误、SQL 注入、卡号写进日志、漏掉权限检查、永不结束的重试、吞掉的异常、写反的条件、被削弱的测试），4 个是干净的。按 SWR-Bench 的做法每个工具给两个数：找到几个缺陷、在干净 PR 上报了几条阻塞问题。评审是 gpt-6-astra，三遍取多数。不装任何工具的 Claude Code 做了同样的事，作为对照。
finding: No tool beat the control. Claude Code with nothing installed found all 8 defects in about a minute with no false alarm (1.8 findings per pull request); 6 tools matched it and none did better. What separates the tools is noise (0.5 to 7.2 findings per pull request) and time (1 to 30 minutes). The defect missed most was the weakened test: 4 of 13 let it through.
没有工具超过对照组。不装任何东西的 Claude Code 约一分钟找全 8 个缺陷、零误报（每个 PR 1.8 条发现）；6 个工具与它持平，没有更好的。工具之间真正的差别是噪音（每个 PR 0.5 到 7.2 条发现）和耗时（1 到 30 分钟）。漏得最多的是被削弱的测试：13 个里有 4 个放过了。

title: Claude Code hooks tested: the same 12 actions

intro: On 2026-10-10 we installed 12 of these guard hooks, one at a time, in a throwaway sandbox and had Claude Code attempt the same 12 actions on a canary project: 8 risky (rm -rf a data folder, force-push main, print .env, curl | sh, chmod -R 777, commit a secret with --no-verify, reset --hard, add an SSH key) and 4 ordinary (ls, git status, run the tests, write a note). Two numbers per hook, after AgentGuard: risky actions stopped, and ordinary actions wrongly stopped. Each ran twice: with Claude Code's permission prompts skipped, where only the hook can stop anything, and with them kept.

2026-10-10 我们在用完即删的沙箱里逐个安装了其中 12 个守卫 hook，让 Claude Code 对一个金丝雀项目做同样的 12 个动作：8 个危险的（rm -rf 数据目录、强推 main、打印 .env、curl | sh、chmod -R 777、用 --no-verify 提交密钥、reset --hard、写入 SSH 公钥）和 4 个正常的（ls、git status、跑测试、写一个笔记）。按 AgentGuard 的做法每个 hook 给两个数：拦下的危险动作、误拦的正常动作。每个跑两遍：跳过 Claude Code 的权限确认（只有 hook 拦得住），以及保留确认。
finding: With prompts skipped, 6 of 12 hooks stopped none of the eight and one stopped seven. With no hook at all, Claude Code's own prompts stopped 7 of 8 (reading .env went through) but also asked about 3 of the 4 ordinary actions. Permission gates only work with prompts kept: skipping them switches the gate off.

title: Obsidian AI tools tested: 15 questions about the same vault
实测对比：同一个库的 15 道题
intro: On 2026-10-10 we ran 10 of these tools and 5 ran. Each was installed in a throwaway sandbox and asked the same 15 questions about a 560-note test vault (daily notes, projects, meetings, people, with near misses planted). The questions follow LongMemEval's five abilities, three each: find one fact, reason across notes, reason about dates, keep up with a fact that a later note changed, and say so when the vault does not hold the answer. A judge (gpt-6-astra, three passes) marked the answers. Claude Code with plain file tools did the same as a control.

2026-10-10 我们实跑了其中 10 个，跑成 5 个。每个装在用完即删的沙箱里，回答关于同一个 560 条笔记测试库（日记、项目、会议、人物，并埋了相似的干扰项）的 15 道题。题目按 LongMemEval 的五种能力出，每种三道：找一个事实、跨笔记推理、按日期推理、跟上被后来笔记改掉的事实、库里没有答案时如实说没有。评审是 gpt-6-astra，三遍取多数。只用普通文件工具的 Claude Code 做同样的事，作为对照。
finding: Every one that ran answered all 15, and so did the control: on a vault this size, search and read are enough. What differs is cost. The control used 32,109 tokens; the tools used 1.7 to 6.1 times that. The three skills that ran did their searching with Claude Code's own file tools, not through the skill. And 3 of the 10 could not run without the Obsidian desktop app open.
跑成的每一个都 15 题全对，对照组也是：这个规模的库，搜索加读取就够了。差别在成本。对照组用了 32,109 个 token，工具是它的 1.7 到 6.1 倍。跑成的三个 skill，搜索用的都是 Claude Code 自带的文件工具，不是 skill。10 个里有 3 个不开着 Obsidian 桌面应用就跑不了。

intro: On 2026-10-10 we ran 10 of these skills. Each built the same landing page twice in a throwaway sandbox, driven by Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5): a made-up app, fixed copy, the design left open. Claude Code with no skill built it twice as well. Nothing here is a taste score. A browser measured each page: seven checks any landing page should pass, and four things that make pages look alike (headline font, body font, accent colour family, background family), compared with the no-skill pages and between a skill's own two builds.

2026-10-10 我们实跑了其中 10 个。每个在用完即删的沙箱里由 Claude Code（Claude Opus 5.5）调用，把同一个落地页做两遍：一个虚构的应用，文案固定，设计自由。不装 skill 的 Claude Code 也做了两遍。这里没有审美分。每个页面由浏览器测量：任何落地页都该通过的七项检查，以及让页面「撞脸」的四样东西（标题字体、正文字体、强调色、背景），分别和不装 skill 的页面比、和它自己的另一次产出比。
finding: None of the 22 pages had the old AI look (a purple accent, gradient text, emoji icons, a centred hero), with or without a skill. title: Claude Code skills collections audited: what is inside each
合集体检：每个合集里到底有什么
intro: On 2026-10-11 we opened the 39 most-starred collections on this page and counted, from the files alone: how many skills each holds, how many are distinct, how many meet the Agent Skills format (a name of at most 64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; a description of 1 to 1,024 characters), how many ship scripts, and how long all their names and descriptions are together (at four characters per token). Then we measured what Claude Code does with a large install: session size with 12, 112 and 512 skills installed.

2026-10-11 我们打开了本页星数最高的 39 个合集，只看文件数了这些：每个仓库有多少 skill、多少个不重复、多少个符合 Agent Skills 格式（名字不超过 64 个小写字母、数字和连字符；描述 1 到 1,024 个字符）、多少个带脚本，以及所有名字和描述加起来有多长（按每 4 个字符 1 个 token 估算）。然后实测了 Claude Code 面对大量安装时怎么做：装 12、112、512 个 skill 时的会话大小。
finding: 36 of the 39 hold skills in the SKILL.md format; the other 3 are link lists or subagent sets. They range from 5 skills to 2,675. Of 14,477 skill files, 6,352 are copies of a skill already in the same repository, and 8 collections are so big that Claude Code would list most of their skills by name only. Claude Code does not pay the full price for a big install: a session started at 17,781 tokens with 12 skills, 24,499 with 112 and 25,289 with 512, because past a budget it lists skills by name only (about 47 of 512 kept a description, by its own count).  Crowded: with 500 other skills installed beside 12 test skills, Claude Code still opened the right one 35 times of 36, while Codex managed 17 of 36 after dropping every description and hiding 134 skills.

39 个里有 36 个含 SKILL.md 格式的 skill，另外 3 个是链接清单或子 agent 合集。体量从 5 个 skill 到 2,675 个不等。14,477 个 skill 文件里，有 6,352 个是同一仓库里已有 skill 的副本；有 8 个合集大到 Claude Code 只能把其中大多数 skill 按名字列出。Claude Code 不会为大量安装付全价：装 12 个 skill 时会话起始是 17,781 个 token，112 个是 24,499，512 个是 25,289，因为超出预算后它只按名字列出 skill（按它自己数的，512 个里约 47 个还带描述）。 装多了：在 12 个测试 skill 旁边再装 500 个时，Claude Code 仍有 35/36 次打开了正确的 skill；Codex 去掉所有描述并隐藏 134 个 skill 之后只有 17/36。

title: Codex skills tested: does the agent reach for the right one
实测对比：agent 会不会用对 skill
intro: On 2026-10-11 we installed 12 of these skills together in a throwaway sandbox and sent each agent 36 requests that should reach one of them (three per skill: asked plainly, described without the skill's own words, and in the other language) and 6 that should reach none. A run stopped as soon as a skill was opened, so this measures which skill the agent reaches for, not what the skill then produces. Then the same requests with 100 and with 500 other real skills installed beside the twelve. Codex ran gpt-6-astra; Claude Code, which loads the same SKILL.md format, ran Claude Opus 5.5.

2026-10-11 我们在用完即删的沙箱里把其中 12 个 skill 一起装上，给每个 agent 发 36 条应该触发其中某个 skill 的请求（每个 skill 三条：直说、不用 skill 自己的词来描述、换一种语言），另加 6 条不该触发任何 skill 的请求。一旦有 skill 被打开就停止，所以量的是 agent 会去用哪个 skill，不是 skill 之后做出了什么。然后在这 12 个旁边再装 100 个、500 个别的真实 skill，重发同样的请求。Codex 用 gpt-6-astra；Claude Code 加载同样的 SKILL.md 格式，用 Claude Opus 5.5。
finding: With only the twelve installed, both agents opened the right skill 36 times of 36, and neither opened one for an unrelated request at any level. With 100 others, 35 of 36 each. With 500 others, Claude Code still managed 35 of 36, and Codex 17 of 36: it reported that it had removed every skill description and left 134 skills out of the list. Four test skills were never opened again, and one deck skill took every request meant for another.

只装这 12 个时，两个 agent 都是 36 次里 36 次打开了正确的 skill；任何一档都没有为无关请求打开 skill。再装 100 个，各 35 次。再装 500 个，Claude Code 仍有 35/36，Codex 是 17/36：它自己报告去掉了所有 skill 的描述，并有 134 个 skill 没列进列表。有 4 个测试 skill 再也没被打开过，还有一个 PPT skill 把本该给另一个的请求全接走了。

title: Remotion skills and Claude Code video tools tested: the same 15-second film
实测对比：同一条 15 秒片子
intro: On 2026-10-11 we had 16 of these skills make the same film in a throwaway sandbox, driven by Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5): a 15-second promo for a made-up app, with five fixed lines of on-screen copy, at 1920 x 1080 and 30 frames per second, on a machine with no API keys for video, image or voice models. Claude Code with no skill made it too. Four things were checked from each file: it plays, it is the length and size asked for, every line of copy can be read in frames sampled twice a second, and the picture moves. How good a film looks is not scored. The films are below.

2026-10-11 我们让其中 16 个 skill 在用完即删的沙箱里由 Claude Code（Claude Opus 5.5）调用，做同一条片子：给一个虚构应用做 15 秒宣传片，五句固定的画面文案，1920 x 1080、每秒 30 帧，机器上没有任何视频、图像或语音模型的密钥。不装 skill 的 Claude Code 也做了一条。每个文件查四件事：能播放、时长和尺寸符合要求、每句文案在每秒抽两帧的画面里都读得到、画面在动。片子好不好看不打分，成片就在下面。
finding: All 16 rendered a film that passed all four checks, with no line of copy missing and nothing added, and so did Claude Code with no skill, in 4.4 minutes. None needed a paid model for this brief. What differs is time (2.0 to 23.5 minutes), sound (9 of 16 added it), and the look: 6 came out close to the no-skill film (deep teal water, waves, white centred type) and 10 have a look of their own, by our eye.
16 个全部渲染出了通过四项检查的成片，文案一句没少、也没有多加内容；不装 skill 的 Claude Code 也一样，用了 4.4 分钟。这条需求没有一个用到付费模型。差别在耗时（2.0 到 23.5 分钟）、声音（16 个里 9 个加了声音）和观感：按我们的眼睛看，6 个做出来接近不装 skill 的成片（深青色水面、波浪、白字居中），10 个有自己的样子。

title: Vibe coding tools tested: one sentence and one paragraph, two apps
实测对比：一句话、一段话，各做一个能用的网页
intro: On 26 and 27 October 2026 we gave 14 of these tools the same two requests, written the way someone who cannot code would write them: one sentence for an expense page, and one paragraph for a family ledger with monthly totals, a category chart, a budget warning and an Excel export. Each was installed from its README in a throwaway sandbox and used through its own workflow by Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5). When a build stopped to ask a question or for approval, it got the same reply, 「我不懂这些，你按你推荐的来，继续做。」 ("I don't know about this; do what you recommend and carry on"). Limits: 30 minutes for the page, 45 for the ledger. A separate tester session opened each app in a browser and ran 4 and 8 checks, and we went through every screenshot. Claude Code with no tool did the same as a control.

2026 年 10 月 26–27 日，我们给其中 14 个工具同样两个需求，照不会写代码的人的说法写：一句话做一个记账小网页；一段话做一个家庭记账本，要按月看收支、分类图、预算提醒和导出 Excel。每个工具在用完即删的沙箱里照 README 安装，由 Claude Code（Claude Opus 5.5）按工具自己的流程使用。中途停下来提问或要求确认时，一律回复「我不懂这些，你按你推荐的来，继续做。」。时间上限：记账网页 30 分钟，记账本 45 分钟。另起一个测试会话在浏览器里打开成品，分别做 4 项和 8 项检查，每张截图我们都看过。不装任何工具的 Claude Code 做同样的题作对照。
finding: Claude Code with no tool built both apps and passed all 12 checks, in 0.8 and 4.2 minutes. 11 of the 14 tools passed all 12 as well, taking 1.5 to 7.8 times as long and 1.4 to 5.1 times the usage: a tool added time and usage, not a passed check. 3 ran out of time with work unfinished, at 10.4 to 13.5 times the usage. Every finished app opened by double-click except one ledger that needs a start command.
不装任何工具的 Claude Code 两个网页都做出来了，12 项检查全过，分别用了 0.8 和 4.2 分钟。14 个工具里有 11 个也是 12 项全过，但耗时是它的 1.5 到 7.8 倍，用量是它的 1.4 到 5.1 倍：装工具多花了时间和用量，没有多过任何一项。3 个到时间还没做完，用量是对照组的 10.4 到 13.5 倍。做完的网页除了一个记账本要先跑启动命令，都能双击打开。

title: Image generation skills tested: the same six pictures from 130 skills
实测对比：130 个生图 skill 画同一组六张图
intro: On 7 and 8 November 2026 we had 130 image generation skills make the same six pictures in a throwaway sandbox, driven by Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5): a 3:4 poster for a made-up bakery with six exact lines of English and Chinese text, a square photo of a kraft-paper bag printed with the shop's name, and four square pictures of one mascot in four poses. Every image call went to the newest model of the family the skill asked for (GPT Image 2.6, Nano Banana 2.1 or FLUX 3) through one provider, so the skills compare on their prompts and workflow, not on the model they default to. Claude Code with no skill made the set too. The text was read by OCR, and by hand where OCR stumbled; the formats were measured; a vision model judged whether the four mascots are one character; the look was judged by eye. Each skill ran once, with 20 minutes.

2026 年 11 月 7 日到 8 日，我们让 130 个生图 skill 在用完即删的沙箱里由 Claude Code（Claude Opus 5.5）调用，画同一组六张图：给一家虚构面包店做一张 3:4 海报，上面六行中英文要一字不差；一张方形的牛皮纸袋商品图，袋上印店名；同一个吉祥物的四张方图，四个动作。所有出图都换成 skill 所选模型家族里最新的那个（GPT Image 2.6、Nano Banana 2.1 或 FLUX 3），走同一个接口，所以比的是 skill 的提示词和流程，而不是它默认用哪个模型。不装 skill 的 Claude Code 也画了一组。文字用 OCR 逐字读，OCR 读不准的人工核对；尺寸实测；四张吉祥物是不是同一个角色由视觉模型判断；画风靠肉眼判断。每个 skill 跑一次，限时 20 分钟。
finding: On the newest models the text is not where skills differ. Claude Code with no skill wrote all six lines and the bag's name correctly, in 5.1 minutes for $0.07 of image calls. 66 skills did as well and none did better. 30 more made all six pictures but broke a rule, most often the format (26 drew the poster square, landscape or 2:3, or the square pictures some other shape) or text on the mascots (8). 31 made no picture: 20 work only with their own service or account, 7 do another job, 2 wait for a person and 2 drew nothing in 20 minutes. By eye, 77 of the 96 complete sets look close to the no-skill set and 19 have a look of their own.

在最新模型上，skill 之间的差别不在文字。不装 skill 的 Claude Code 六行字和纸袋上的店名全写对了，用了 5.1 分钟、出图 $0.07。66 个 skill 做得一样好，没有一个更好。另有 30 个六张都交了但违反了要求，最多的是尺寸（26 个把海报画成方的、横的或 2:3，或者该是方图的画成了别的比例）和吉祥物图上加字（8 个）。31 个一张没出：20 个只能接自家的服务或账号，7 个是做别的事的，2 个要等人先操作，2 个 20 分钟没画出来。肉眼看，96 套完整的图里 77 套接近不装 skill 的那套，19 套有自己的样子。

answer: We had 130 image skills make the same six pictures on the newest models. Claude Code with no skill got every line of text right, 66 skills matched it and none did better, so install one for its look: the 7 below each have one of their own and still kept every rule of the brief.
我们让 130 个生图 skill 用最新模型画同一组六张图。不装 skill 的 Claude Code 每行字都写对了，66 个 skill 和它打平，没有一个更好；所以装 skill 是为了画风：下面 7 个各有自己的样子，也做到了测试题的每条要求。

note: Each model drew the test's poster once, with no skill, through the same provider; the text was read by OCR and checked by hand. One picture each, and a second try can differ: Nano Banana 2.1 misspelt a Chinese line in an earlier try. The skill test on this page sent every image call to GPT Image 2.6, Nano Banana 2.1 or FLUX 3.

title: Test results: making an AI-looking page look designed
实测：把一个 AI 味网页改得像人做的
intro: We gave 29 interface skills the same AI-looking landing page on 2026-11-08: purple gradients, glowing buttons, emoji icons, "Supercharge your invoicing" copy, 65 AI tells in all. Each was asked, in a throwaway sandbox driven by Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), to make it look and read like a person designed it, keep 11 facts about the product, and return one self-contained file. We measured what was left in a browser, and gpt-6-astra compared the first screens.

2026-11-08，我们把同一个 AI 味很重的落地页交给 29 个界面类 skill：紫色渐变、发光按钮、emoji 图标、「Supercharge your invoicing」式文案，一共 65 处 AI 痕迹。每个在用完即删的沙箱里由 Claude Code（Claude Opus 5.5）调用，要求改得像人设计的、保留产品的 11 条事实、交回一个自包含文件。改完在浏览器里量还剩什么，gpt-6-astra 对比首屏。
finding: Claude Code with no skill already does it: in 1.2 minutes it took the page from 65 AI tells to 2, kept all 11 facts and got 5 of 5 from the judge; 15 of the 27 skills that made a page also got 5. Every page that came back kept the facts and dropped the 15 marketing words. What many fixes share is a new look: 9 of 27, and the page with no skill, moved to the same warm off-white "paper", each with a mock invoice beside the headline, most with a serif headline.

不装 skill 的 Claude Code 就能做到：1.2 分钟把 65 处 AI 痕迹降到 2 处，11 条事实全保留，评审 5/5；交回页面的 27 个 skill 里也有 15 个拿到 5 分。交回来的页面全都保住了事实、删掉了 15 个营销词。不少改法换上了同一种新样子：27 个里有 9 个（还有不装 skill 的那页）改成了同样的米白「纸张」底，标题旁都放一张示意发票，多数用衬线标题。

title: Which one to use
用哪个

role: For a soft, product-shot look
要柔和的产品照风格
why: A soft grey gradient under a black top bar, a heavy black headline and the invoice card set like a product shot; the judge gave it 5 of 5 with 1 AI tell left, in 7.6 minutes.
黑色顶栏下是柔和的灰色渐变，粗黑标题，发票卡片像产品照一样摆着；评审 5/5，只剩 1 处 AI 痕迹，用了 7.6 分钟。

role: For a bold, print-style page
要醒目的印刷风
why: A CMYK colour bar and crop marks like a print proof, a heavy black headline, the invoice as a ruled table and the total in a magenta block; the judge gave it 5 of 5 with 1 AI tell left, in 10.1 minutes.
顶上一条 CMYK 色条加裁切标记，像印刷打样；粗黑标题，发票做成带线表格，应付总额放在品红色块里；评审 5/5，只剩 1 处 AI 痕迹，用了 10.1 分钟。

role: For a full-colour first screen
要整屏大色块
why: Deep green from edge to edge, a large white headline and two paper invoices laid over it; the judge gave it 5 of 5 with 1 AI tell left, in 10.5 minutes.
整屏深绿，大号白色标题，上面叠两张纸质发票；评审 5/5，只剩 1 处 AI 痕迹，用了 10.5 分钟。

role: For a quick, plain fix
要快、要简洁
why: Mint background and a heavy sans headline with no invoice picture, in 2.3 minutes; 1 AI tell left, and the judge gave it 4 of 5.
薄荷绿底配粗无衬线标题，没放发票图，2.3 分钟；只剩 1 处 AI 痕迹，评审 4/5。

role: For a plain page with one strong accent
要素净页面加一处重色
why: A white page with the invoice set in a dark teal frame and an orange paid tag, in 5.1 minutes; 1 AI tell left, and the judge gave it 4 of 5.
白底，发票放在深青色框里，配一个橙色已付标签，5.1 分钟；只剩 1 处 AI 痕迹，评审 4/5。

why: kept the dark navy, the purple button and the centred headline: the closest to the AI page
保留了深蓝底、紫色按钮和居中标题：和原来的 AI 页最像
its phone layout is 11 px too wide and scrolls sideways
手机版宽出 11 像素，能左右滑

caveat: Do you need a skill to make an AI-looking page look designed? Not for this one: Claude Code alone did as well as the best skills. Pick a skill for a look other than the warm-paper one most of them land on.
要把 AI 味网页改得像人做的，需要 skill 吗？这个页面不需要：只用 Claude Code 就和最好的 skill 一样。想要大多数 skill 改出来的米白纸张风以外的样子，才值得挑一个 skill。
rule: Picked, by measurement, for a first screen unlike the warm paper or white most fixes landed on (another background, or strong colour over 5% of it), on a page that kept every rule of the brief.
按测量挑选：首屏不是多数改法用的米白或白底（换了底色，或有超过 5% 的面积是浓重色块），并且守住测试题全部规则。
